info.name: Registration
info.description:
Rhythm ERP Registration module endpoints. Base URL: https://rhythmerp.algorhythms.in

Setup:
1. Import this collection
2. Import the 'Rhythm ERP Environment' alongside it
3. Set your token and tenant_id in the environment
4. Run requests

item.name: Supplier
item.description:
Supplier CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create/Update, GET /Supplier/ for List, GET /Supplier/{id}/ for Detail.

Key rules:
- PAN must be unique across all suppliers (format: ABCDE1234F)
- Both Shipping (address_type=43) AND Billing (address_type=42) rows are mandatory
- mobile_no and bank_account_no must be integers, NOT strings
- GSTIN must pass Luhn mod-36 checksum — random strings are rejected
- No Delete endpoint exists in the ERP

request.description:
Returns paginated flat list of suppliers.

Response: screenmatlistingdata_set[] with id, name, mobile_no, email_id, pan_no, status.
No stepper children in list response — use Get Supplier Detail for full data.

Use search_string to filter by name/PAN.

Returns full supplier record with all stepper children.

children[0] = Additional Details (fields on stepper object, NOT inside details[])
children[1] = Address Details (details[] contains Shipping + Billing rows)
children[2] = Bank Details (details[] contains bank rows)

Set supplier_id in the environment or replace {{supplier_id}} with an actual ID from the List response.

request.description:
⚠️ UPDATE NOTE:

How it works:
  Same endpoint as Create (POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/)
  Same payload structure — only difference is "id" set to existing supplier ID (integer) instead of empty string ""
  The ERP distinguishes Create vs Update solely by the "id" field

Known limitation:
  The ERP UI uses an internal encrypted endpoint (execute-query/) for updates
  Updating via Bearer token alone may hit PAN uniqueness errors or stepper child ID conflicts
  Most reliable update path = Python automation client update_entry(supplier_id, payload) which uses session auth

To test manually:
  1. Run Get Supplier Detail to get the full payload for a supplier
  2. Copy that response, set "id" to the supplier's integer ID
  3. Modify the field you want to change
  4. POST to this endpoint

No Delete:
  The ERP has NO delete endpoint, no delete button, and no soft-delete via status=False
  Created records are permanent — track IDs manually for any DB-level purge

item.name: Customer
item.description:
Customer CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create/Update, GET /Customer/ for List, GET /Customer/{id}/ for Detail.

Key differences from Supplier:
- Root has sale_type_ref_id + supply_type_ref_id (no po_type_ref_id)
- sale_type_ref_id must always be Commission, supply_type_ref_id must always be Both
- Stepper 3 is 'Customer Bank Details' (not 'Bank Details')
- GSTIN and registration_number both validated with Luhn mod-36 checksum
- No Delete endpoint

request.description:
Returns paginated flat list of customers.

Response: screenmatlistingdata_set[] with id, name, mobile_no, email_id, pan_no, status.
No stepper children in list response — use Get Customer Detail for full data.

Use search_string to filter by name/PAN.

Returns full customer record with all stepper children.

children[0] = Additional Details (fields spread directly on stepper object, NOT inside details[])
children[1] = Address Details (details[] contains Shipping + Billing rows)
children[2] = Customer Bank Details (details[] contains bank rows)

To test:
  1. Run Get Customer Detail to fetch the full record
  2. Copy the response, set top-level "id" to the customer's integer ID
  3. Edit the field you want to change
  4. POST to this endpoint

Known limitations:

item.name: Employee
item.description:
Employee CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create, GET /Employee/ for List, GET /Employee/{id}/ for Detail, PUT /Employee/{id}/ for Update.

Key facts:
- FLAT FORM: No steppers, no children array — all fields at root level
- Required: name, email_id, mobile_no, designation, status
- name must match ^[A-Za-z ]+$ (letters and spaces only — no digits or special chars)
- mobile_no must be a 10-digit integer starting with 6-9
- designation and department are FK IDs at root level (not inside children)
- No Delete endpoint

request.description:
Returns paginated flat list of employees.

Response: screenmatlistingdata_set[] with id, name, email_id, mobile_no, designation, status.

Returns full employee record.

Flat structure — no children array. All fields including designation and department are at root level.

Set employee_id in the environment or replace {{employee_id}} with an actual ID from the List response.

Creates a new Employee. Returns 200 (listing page) on success — not 201.

Key field reference:
  designation: 1=Test Designation, 2=Farm Supervisor, 3=Warehouse Manager, 4=Quality Inspector, 5=Procurement Officer, 6=Accounts Executive, 7=Field Officer, 8=Weighbridge Operator, 9=Dispatch Coordinator, 10=Commodity Analyst, 11=Regional Manager, 12=Cashier, 13=Compliance Officer, 14=Data Entry Operator
  department: 1=General, 2=Administration

Common 400 errors:
  - name contains digits or special characters (only letters and spaces allowed)
  - mobile_no is a string instead of integer
  - mobile_no does not start with 6-9 or is not 10 digits
  - designation is null or invalid ID

Updates an existing Employee.

Employee Update uses PUT /Employee/{id}/ — different from Supplier/Customer which use POST to the base endpoint.

Set employee_id in the environment. Run Get Employee Detail first to get the current values, then modify what you need.

item.name: Agent
item.description:
Agent CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create/Update, GET /Agent/ for List, GET /Agent/{id}/ for Detail.

Key facts:
- 3 steppers: Address Details, Payment Details, Bank Details
- Both Shipping (address_type=43) AND Billing (address_type=42) address rows required
- Payment Details fields (payment_terms_ref_id, preferred_payment_method_ref_id) sit on the stepper object itself, NOT inside details[]
- mobile_no and bank_account_no must be integers
- No Delete endpoint

⚠️ UPDATE NOTE:

How it works:
  Same endpoint as Create (POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/)
  Only difference: "id" is set to the existing agent's integer ID

To test:
  1. Run Get Agent Detail to fetch the full record
  2. Copy the response, set top-level "id" to the agent's integer ID
  3. Edit the field you want to change
  4. POST to this endpoint

No Delete:
  No delete endpoint exists in the ERP

item.name: Farmer
item.description:
Farmer CRUD — POST /core/dynamic-screen-wrapper/ for Create/Update, GET /Farmer/ for List, GET /Farmer/{id}/ for Detail.

Key rules:
- farmer_category is a single integer FK (NOT an array)
- Tenant-specific category IDs: 1592=Walk-in, 1593=FPC Member, 1594=Borrower Farmer
- mobile_no and bank_account_no must be integers, NOT strings
- Address requires BOTH Permanent (1875) AND Current (1876) rows
- Additional Details + Other Details: fields sit on the stepper object, NOT inside details[]
- Stepper order: Address, Family, Additional, Other, Land, Crop, KYC, Vehicle, Income, Bank, Irrigation, Award, Loan
- Borrower Farmer = 13 steppers; FPC Member = 6; Walk-in = 3
- No Delete endpoint exists in the ERP
